added.summary: <use href> draws a copy of a symbol (its viewBox fitted by preserveAspectRatio), group or shape that inherits the use's presentation attributes; clip-path and mask cut groups and shapes (a mask of one gradient-filled shape fades); a <pattern> fill tiles its shapes; <image href> draws an atlas image icon or a render texture in its rect; <title> names its parent for assistive technology and binds. Rect, circle and ellipse clips are native; a clip to paths draws uncut with a warning.
With a view box, the sub-rect its non-path shape, clip and paints fill, in view-box units.

fixed.summary: A masked or material layer of an element drawn through a view box composited through its unfitted shape; it now uses the fitted geometry, and a gradient mask in view-box units is fitted as a fill gradient is.
